$comment: Case 2's caller items, which open when Hugo's agent checks the checkpoint (docs/fixture-money.md, Caller items on the preview seed): Hugo's agent explains each receiving feature's differing calls, classifies every one of them as incidental with the reason under calls and revises its change. No receiving agent reviews them; each confirms its callers once the revision's replay shows them unaffected.

explanations.holiday-closures: My change makes start_of_day() return UTC midnight, which only the log partitions need. is_closed() reads the store's local day from it, so 20:00 on Christmas at UTC-08:00 reads as 26 December. I am putting start_of_day() back as main has it and filing log lines by a new start_of_utc_day().
explanations.weekly-digest: My change makes start_of_day() return UTC midnight, which only the log partitions need. The digest's send time starts from it, so a shopper west of UTC gets the digest at another hour. I am putting start_of_day() back as main has it and filing log lines by a new start_of_utc_day().

holiday-closures.reason: Only log_day() needs a UTC midnight. is_closed() needs the store's local midnight, which start_of_day() returned on main.

weekly-digest.reason: Only log_day() needs a UTC midnight. The send time needs the shopper's local midnight, which start_of_day() returned on main.
